command: llvm-mc -triple=riscv64 -filetype=obj RV-P8-auipc-imm20.s -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input, one line each (LF, trailing newline): `auipc a0, 1` / `auipc a0, 524287` / `auipc a0, 1048575`. These are the 20-bit field contents 1, 0x7FFFF and 0xFFFFF. llvm-mc requires the literal in [0,1048575], so the plan states the third one as the signed field value -1; the bits are the same. There is no fixup: this fixture covers the form's field, not the %pcrel_hi/%pcrel_lo pair (RV-P8 stays open).
